title.en: Terminal molecular total energy conservation diagnostic
title.zh: 终态分子总能量守恒诊断

summary: Reduce caller-owned qxH2_total and QH2_total profiles to a source-defined dimensionless conservation-error diagnostic.

identity.relation: reduce caller-owned qxh2_total and qh2_total profiles to a source-defined dimensionless conservation-error diagnostic.
identity.definition: Reduce caller-owned qxH2_total and QH2_total profiles to a source-defined dimensionless conservation-error diagnostic.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim and reproduced bit for bit on the declared legal domain
identity.geometry: zero-dimensional profile relation over 1-D spatial/velocity axes
identity.coordinates: positions in m, velocities in normalized units, temperature in eV; diagnostics in source-defined units
identity.boundary: finite nonnegative aligned input profiles; positive thermal speed; nonzero spatial spacing
assumptions: The saved formal operator is ported verbatim; no repair is claimed.
No external atomic-physics reference is bound: the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.

inputs.name: axial_position_m
inputs.constraints: Finite, strictly increasing (nonzero diff), at least two nodes.

inputs.name: total_energy_transfer_rate_profile_w_m3
inputs.description: The total energy transfer rate profile.

preconditions: Finite nonnegative aligned input profiles; positive thermal speed where applicable.
supported: Terminal molecular diagnostics for H2 neutral transport.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when inputs are non-finite, shape-incompatible, or violate nonnegativity constraints.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the diagnostic produces a non-finite result.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

provenance.lineage_summary: Development integration from the saved KN1DPy terminal conservation diagnostic package, source anchor KN1DPy/kinetic_h2.py:1755-1790, as recorded by the saved bundle's own provenance section. Saved implementation file SHA-256 258ef36f7d265f5a7cc08f021cbf91fbd83ad9ce6876a1c56d1064655d4c2af3. The saved formal implementation is ported verbatim and reproduced bit for bit on the declared legal domain; no repair is claimed. KN1DPy's strict D1 qualification has been withdrawn and the bundle sits in the re-review archive, so all of this is bounded historical development comparison, not qualified-L1 provenance and not expert approval.
source_kinds: saved L1 operator document and implementation

example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import reduce_qh2_total_conservation_diagnostic
x = np.linspace(0, 1, 3)
result = reduce_qh2_total_conservation_diagnostic(x, np.ones(3), np.ones(3))
assert result['total_energy_conservation_error_profile_dimensionless'].shape == (3,)
example.expected: The callable exists and returns a finite result.
